headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 26, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Chicago Cubs 2-1 in a closely contested game, with Michael Busch leading the Cubs' offense with a home run and one RBI. The Baltimore Orioles secured a crucial win over the Tampa Bay Rays 9-7, with Jonathan Aranda leading the Rays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Athletics right-hander Aaron Civale, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder tendinitis. Other notable injuries include Noah Schultz of the Chicago White Sox, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 25, 2026, due to right knee patellar tendinitis.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Carson Palmquist, who was traded to the team from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cubs in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Chicago Cubs 2-1, securing their win in a closely contested game. Michael Busch led the Cubs' offense with a home run and one RBI, while Ben Brown pitched 6 strong innings for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles edged the Tampa Bay Rays 9-7, securing a crucial win. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 3-1 decision to the Chicago White Sox, with Drew Romo's 5th home run of the season not enough to secure a win. Anthony Kay earned the win for the White Sox, pitching 6.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Brewers in 5-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals were defeated by the Milwaukee Brewers with a final score of 5-1. Christian Yelich led the Brewers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics RHP Aaron Civale Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Athletics right-hander Aaron Civale has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder tendinitis. The move is effective immediately.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Carson Palmquist, who was traded to the team from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for cash. Palmquist joins the Nationals' roster on May 25, 2026.
